items.question: How much does professional packing cost?
items.answer: Packing is priced per hour plus materials. A standard 2-bedroom home takes 4–6 hours with two packers — typically $400–$700 including boxes and paper. A 3–4 bedroom home runs $700–$1,400. We give you a fixed materials estimate upfront.

items.question: How long does it take to pack a house?
items.answer: A studio or 1-bedroom: 2–4 hours. A 2-bedroom: 4–6 hours. A 3-bedroom: 6–10 hours. A 4+ bedroom: full day or two. Fragile-heavy homes (lots of china, collectibles) take longer — we'll tell you upfront.

items.question: Can you pack just the kitchen or fragile rooms?
items.answer: Yes — partial packing is one of our most popular services. Most people can pack clothes and books themselves but want help with kitchens, china cabinets, and garages. Pick any rooms you want covered.

items.question: Do you offer labor-only for PODS or U-Haul?
items.answer: Yes. Bring your own container or rental truck, we bring the crew. 2-hour minimum. We load, unload, or both. Same hourly rate as full moves.

items.question: What materials do you bring?
items.answer: Boxes (small, medium, large, dish-pack, wardrobe, TV), packing paper, bubble wrap, tape, furniture pads, and shrink wrap. You don't buy a thing. Leftover unused materials are credited back.

items.question: Can you pack the day before the move?
items.answer: Yes, and most clients prefer it. Pack day 1, move day 2 — less stress, fewer mistakes. We can also pack and move same day if timeline is tight.

items.question: Do you unpack at the destination?
items.answer: Yes. Unpacking is a separate service — boxes emptied, items placed on surfaces, debris hauled away. Priced hourly. Most people do it for kitchens and closets only.
